title: A deadly exam
text: Answer wizarding-world trivia on your phone. Everyone answers every question.

scene.tv: Which plant screams when pulled up?

title: Wrong? Detention!
text: Living students who answer wrong go to detention, a deadly mini-game. Fail it and you become a ghost.

title: Ghosts keep playing
text: Ghosts still answer questions, so nobody sits out.

title: The Midnight Escape
text: After the exam, everyone races to the castle gate. Ghosts start behind but can catch up and come back to life!
